CueMediaPreviewEntry.description: One Cue whose preview a Media Server draws.

layer.description: Zero-based layer for a layer preview.

layer_fixture_id.description: The layer's logical-head fixture for a layer preview.

output_id.description: The server's patched output, or `None` when the fixture follows the server's first output.

preview_key.description:
Changes whenever the picture would: a different server, output, layer, or programmed
state. A desk uses it as the image's cache identity.

server_fixture_id.description: The patched Media Server fixture (the parent that owns the master and the layer heads).

CueMediaPreviewScope.description: Whether a Cue previews a whole output or one logical layer.

oneOf.description: The composited Program image of the Media Server output, master included.
One logical layer's composited image, with its transparency kept.
